method: Three expanding chronological test folds; four-row purge; same-session target windows; 0.50 probability threshold for classification; trading threshold selected only on an earlier purged validation slice.

cost_assumption.note: Cost proxy only, not complete Indian brokerage, taxes, spread or slippage.

aggregation.mean_fold_metrics: Arithmetic mean of each stock's fold metrics.
aggregation.pooled_metrics: Confusion counts summed across folds, then metrics derived.
aggregation.macro: Equal-stock mean of per-stock pooled metrics; not a portfolio return.

limitations: Three folds are an initial research comparison, not proof of generalization.
News coverage may be sparse and missing news is represented neutrally.
Sentiment uses the project's existing keyword baseline.
Class-weight comparisons do not guarantee improved prediction quality.
No orders are placed and no trading readiness is inferred.
